title: Repeated compound register transactions
purpose: Exercise repeated compound read/write processing with different ranges and payload widths, exposing transaction-state and counted-data interactions across two complete requests.
expected_behavior: The server should parse each compound request, apply or reject the write range according to normal device policy, and produce a normal read response or a standard exception while maintaining transaction boundaries.
constraints_preserved: Each message has a seven-byte Modbus/TCP MBAP header
The first MBAP length 000f matches a unit identifier plus fourteen-byte PDU
The second MBAP length 000d matches a unit identifier plus twelve-byte PDU
Read and write quantities match their corresponding address fields
Each write byte count matches the number of encoded register data bytes
Transaction identifiers and unit identifiers differ between messages
issue_safety_notes: These are fresh compound request analogues for repeated server processing and state-sensitive handling. They do not reproduce the reported multi-request stream or assume the suspected use-after-free cause is confirmed.
